leakProbe.verdict: sets differ a lot — expected for illiquid coins; the SIGNAL is still past-only by construction

limitations: SURVIVORSHIP: coins that fell to zero and were delisted are absent from 2020-2026 data, so the small-cap result is an UPPER BOUND.
The signal is read through PointInTime.asOf, which throws on any read past the cutoff — so the trend leg cannot look ahead. The liquidity ranking is also past-only.
Costs are charged on rebalance days only (90-day cadence), which understates the true round trip of an illiquid exit.
conclusion: small-cap effect looks real, survivorship caveat applies
